usedFor: webCRM holds organisations, opportunities and support cases, and Google Docs receives the write-up through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity Created” in webCRM, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new opportunity becomes text in a doc tab, ready to share with the team.

watchOut: Every webCRM trigger in this pair is polling, so “New Opportunity Created” reaches Google Docs after a scheduled check.
